comment: Occurrences of a case/source token that tools/check_case_token_leakage.py finds in a protected zone and does not report.  Keys are POSITION-AWARE: '<relative path>::<position>::<kind>::<text>'.  An entry suppresses exactly the occurrence it names and nothing else, so the same spelling in a different position is still reported.  Every entry needs a written reason; a reason that is empty or starts with TODO/UNREVIEWED/FIXME/XXX suppresses nothing.  A reason starting with 'LEGITIMATE' records a decision that the position is data; a reason starting with 'DEBT' records a REAL violation that is carried, not excused, and must be retired.  Never add an entry to make a new violation pass.
key_format: <relative path>::<position>::<kind>::<text>  --  position is an RFC 6901 JSON Pointer for .json, '<scope qualname>#<ordinal>' for .py, '#<ordinal>' for .rs

known_violations.woof/data/certification/t0_state_parity_: LEGITIMATE: an entry of the t=0 digest receipt's input inventory -- the name of a file that was actually staged and hashed. The inventory exists so a later statement about what was scored is checkable against the receipt, so the recorded name has to be the real one; scrubbing the campaign spelling out of it would destroy the provenance the field is for. Nothing generic reads this value: the digest discovers frames from the directory listing and holds no case name of its own.

known_violations.woof/physics_registry_v2.json::/componen: LEGITIMATE: a refused_when rule's 'sources' clause is the declarative list of forcing sources one physical incompatibility applies to, read one entry at a time exactly as this gate intends and exactly as the source_ids entries above are.  The physics is source-independent; what is source-dependent is whether the analysis SUPPLIES condensate, and that is a fact about the source, not about the scheme.  This entry says the analysis of this one source carries QC/QR/QI/QS/QG that microphysics off would drop at initialization, so plan review refuses the pairing before step 0 instead of woof/ingest/real.py refusing it after.  The rule ITSELF is generic (woof/physics_registry.py _conditional_refusal_fires resolves any sources clause for any source), so a second source with the same analysis is a row, never a code path.  Retiring the entry means declaring per-source analysis inventories somewhere a protected module can resolve them, which no in-tree table states yet.

unconverted_legacy_entries.note: These entries were recorded under the OLD position-blind key '<path>::<text>' for crates/rw-sim/src/*.rs, which lives in the RW-Studio Rust workspace, NOT in this repository.  They are kept for the record and SUPPRESS NOTHING.  They were not mechanically converted to position-aware keys because that worktree (branch codex/rwwps-simulation-studio, commit 31b681e) has drifted past this recording: it now contains 'CertifiedHrrrWsm6YsuNoah' in both physics.rs and runtime.rs, which no recorded entry covers, while 'hrrr_download', 'certified_hrrr_wsm6_ysu_noah' and 'woof.hrrr_hierarchy_direct' have gone.  Regenerating from that tree would silently bless the drift.  Whoever owns rw-sim must re-baseline it there against a scan of its own HEAD, with a reason per entry.
